note: Frozen twelve-round comparison for the step-handoff question. Three LIBERO init indices (0, 1, 2), one official English instruction for every round so language cannot explain a difference, two handoff modes (action_retreat, robot_state_restore), two runs each, interleaved mode-by-mode inside each init. Every round loads task 8 at that init and never resets, reloads, mutates the BDDL or teleports an object inside the episode. Rounds are never retried or skipped; failures stay. The two runs per cell are repeatability, not independent inits: all rounds of one init start from the same frozen scene. Same code path as the earlier six-round acceptance; the modes differ only in how the arm is handed over.

policy_randomness.note: the resident OpenWAM server exposes no per-episode sampling seed, so action sampling draws from its ambient RNG; the scene init is fixed by the env seed
